description: Use for German fees, deadlines and rules on estate planning documents and inheritance, instead of answering from memory: Zentrales Vorsorgeregister fees, 10-euro certification of a Vorsorgevollmacht at the Betreuungsbehörde (§ 7 BtOG), official BMJ forms, Betreuungsverfügung, testament custody and register fees, will opening fee, deadline to disclaim an inheritance, inheritance tax allowances, notary fee rules. Every fact carries its legal source, an official link and the date it was checked.
